-- 139_346.sql
-- Looker Query Context '{"user_id":218,"history_slug":"9c697c1b74f66fd1eba20bf27c90fae7","instance_slug":"c59fc17fc46e0aeaf86d35ed33635ddc"}' 
SELECT
    provider_provider.name_english  AS "provider_provider.name_english",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_order.state='delivered' THEN order_order.id END ) AS "order_order.count_of_completed_orders",
    cast(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ( cast(date_diff('second', (date_add('hour', timezone_hour(at_timezone(order_order.estimated_delivery_initial, admin_system_city.timezone)), order_order.estimated_delivery_initial)), (date_add('hour', timezone_hour(at_timezone(delivered_state_log.created, admin_system_city.timezone)), delivered_state_log.created))) as real)/60 )<=5.0 AND  order_order.state  ='delivered' THEN  order_order.id   END) as real)/NULLIF(( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_order.state='delivered' THEN order_order.id END ) ),0)   AS "order_order.percent_of_on_time_deliveries",
    (( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN 1.0*date_diff('second', order_order_all_states_together.courier_arrived_to_provider, order_order_all_states_together.courier_picked_up)/60.0 <= 5.0 THEN order_order_all_states_together.order_id END) )*1.0)/NULLIF(( COUNT(DISTINCT order_order_all_states_together.order_id) ),0) AS "order_order_all_states_together.percent_orders_with_courier_in_store_time_no_more_than_5_minutes",
    (COALESCE(CAST( ( SUM(DISTINCT (CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE( ( cast(date_diff('second', order_order_provider.created, order_order_provider.estimated_item_ready_time) as real) / 60  )  ,0)*(1000000*1.0)) AS DECIMAL(38,0))) + (CAST(FROM_BASE(SUBSTR(TO_HEX(MD5(CAST(CAST( order_order_provider.id   AS VARCHAR) AS VARBINARY))),1,14),16) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) * CAST(10000000000 AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) + CAST(FROM_BASE(SUBSTR(TO_HEX(MD5(CAST(CAST( order_order_provider.id   AS VARCHAR) AS VARBINARY))), 17, 10), 16) AS DECIMAL(38, 0))) ) - SUM(DISTINCT (CAST(FROM_BASE(SUBSTR(TO_HEX(MD5(CAST(CAST( order_order_provider.id   AS VARCHAR) AS VARBINARY))),1,14),16) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) * CAST(10000000000 AS DECIMAL(38, 0)) + CAST(FROM_BASE(SUBSTR(TO_HEX(MD5(CAST(CAST( order_order_provider.id   AS VARCHAR) AS VARBINARY))), 17, 10), 16) AS DECIMAL(38, 0)))) )  AS DOUBLE) / CAST((1000000*1.0) AS DOUBLE), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN   ( cast(date_diff('second', order_order_provider.created, order_order_provider.estimated_item_ready_time) as real) / 60  )   IS NOT NULL THEN  order_order_provider.id   ELSE NULL END), 0)) AS "order_order_provider.average_actual_cooking_time_minutes",
    AVG(cast(date_diff('second', order_order_all_states_together.courier_waiting_for_confirmation, order_order_all_states_together.courier_accepted) as real)/60 ) AS "order_order_all_states_together.average_courier_acceptance_time",
    AVG(cast(date_diff('second', order_order_all_states_together.courier_accepted, order_order_all_states_together.courier_arrived_to_provider) as real)/60 ) AS "order_order_all_states_together.average_courier_arrived_to_provider",
    AVG(cast(date_diff('second', order_order_all_states_together.courier_arrived_to_provider, order_order_all_states_together.courier_picked_up) as real)/60 ) AS "order_order_all_states_together.average_courier_waiting_to_pickup",
    AVG(cast(date_diff('second', order_order_all_states_together.courier_picked_up, order_order_all_states_together.order_delivered) as real)/60 ) AS "order_order_all_states_together.courier_delivery_time_after_food_is_ready"
FROM ng_delivery.delivery_order_order_local  AS order_order
LEFT JOIN ng_delivery.delivery_order_order_provider  AS order_order_provider ON order_order.id = order_order_provider.order_id 
LEFT JOIN admin_system_city  AS admin_system_city ON order_order.city_id=admin_system_city.id 
LEFT JOIN looker_scratch.LR_admin_system_country AS admin_system_country ON admin_system_city.country_code=admin_system_country.code 
LEFT JOIN ng_delivery.delivery_order_order_state_log  AS delivered_state_log ON order_order.id=delivered_state_log.order_id AND order_order.city_id = delivered_state_log.city_id AND delivered_state_log.to_state = 'delivered' 
LEFT JOIN ng_delivery.etl_delivery_order_all_states_together  AS order_order_all_states_together ON order_order.id=order_order_all_states_together.order_id 
LEFT JOIN looker_scratch.LR_provider_provider AS provider_provider ON order_order.provider_id=provider_provider.id 
WHERE ((( order_order.created_date  ) >= ((DATE_ADD('day', -1, CAST(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2024-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP)))) AND ( order_order.created_date  ) < ((DATE_ADD('day', 1, DATE_ADD('day', -1, CAST(CAST(DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST('2024-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP))))))) AND (provider_provider.vendor_id ) IN (1, 546)
GROUP BY
    1
ORDER BY
    1
LIMIT 50
